label: batch-57
tail:
Batch 57 authoring is complete. The A/B pages, manifests, coverage, contracts, cross batch evidence, notes, and 30 author readiness records are in place. Supplier statuses remain draft; no acceptance is inferred.

The geometric soundness proof handles dirty ancillas explicitly and derives the \(1/(2N^3)\) energy bound. The batch also includes the witness interface and uniform circuit interpreter needed to connect input dependent matrix tests to the QC14 verifier model.

Checks passed: proof layout (30 items, 64 steps), precheck (23 proofs), strict proof contracts (30/30), scoped dependency checks, rendercheck (32 files), and source fetch (10/10). The Arora–Barak theorem source was fetched from the authors’ Princeton site after the Duke index returned 403; the relevant proof appears in [Chapter 6](https://theory.cs.princeton.edu/complexity/book.pdf). The [KKR paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/quant-ph/0406180), [Watrous](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0804.3401), and [de Wolf](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1907.09415) are also recorded in the coverage ledger.

The full run still has owner side blockers: dependency checks report an empty unrelated scaffold and stale QA34 levels; the batch dependency hash needs refreshing after the assigned manifest update; and the full run readiness check stops at malformed YAML in an unrelated draft. The 30 batch 57 readiness records have current hashes.
